# PrintedElectrodeArchitecture

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The geometric and material design of printed electrodes (e.g., interdigitated, microband) that determines sensitivity, response time, and integration compatibility. Optimizing electrode geometry is key to embedding sensors into compact, topology-aware computing nodes without compromising signal integrity.
